calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_data AS (
    -- Store transactions: net sales and receipt count
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS store_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900  -- physical stores only
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag  -- staff purchases out
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'  -- test articles out
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_data AS (
    -- Web transactions: net sales and order count
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS web_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'  -- web sales lines
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'  -- exclude cancelled
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag  -- staff purchases out (consistent with store ATV exclusion)
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'  -- test articles out
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((SELECT store_net_sales FROM store_data) + (SELECT web_net_sales FROM web_data), 2) AS total_net_sales,
    (SELECT store_receipts FROM store_data) + (SELECT web_orders FROM web_data) AS total_transactions,
    ROUND(((SELECT store_net_sales FROM store_data) + (SELECT web_net_sales FROM web_data)) / ((SELECT store_receipts FROM store_data) + (SELECT web_orders FROM web_data)), 2) AS atv_including_web

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)
SELECT 'Physical stores' AS channel,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transactions,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Web',
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2),
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2)
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period

ORDER BY channel;

WITH params AS (

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders_count
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)

FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS dispatch_date_count,
    MIN(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS min_dispatch_date,
    MAX(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS max_dispatch_date
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'collected');

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS web_sales_lines,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS web_orders_from_lines,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)
SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY s.store_id

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_data AS (
    -- Physical store transactions
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS store_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_data AS (
    -- Web transactions: identified by joining to fact_web_order
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS web_net_sales,
        COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 0) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT store_net_sales FROM store_data) +
        (SELECT web_net_sales FROM web_data) AS total_net_sales,
        (SELECT store_receipts FROM store_data) +
        (SELECT web_orders FROM web_data) AS total_transactions
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(total_net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
    total_transactions AS transactions,
    ROUND(total_net_sales / total_transactions, 2) AS atv
FROM totals;
